story.iWant: to practice with word lists and custom character sets
story.soThat: I can focus on specific typing weaknesses and build muscle memory
story.tasks:
- Task 1: Word Mode Implementation (AC: 1, 2, 3) - Create word database with frequency rankings - Implement word count adjustment controls - Develop word frequency sorting algorithm - Add support for multiple language word lists
- Task 2: Character Mode Implementation (AC: 4, 5, 6) - Create character set selection interface - Implement character group management system - Develop text generation from character sets - Add finger-based character grouping visualization
- Task 3: Mode UI Components (AC: 1-6) - Create WordMode component extending TypingArea - Create CharacterMode component extending TypingArea - Implement mode switching interface - Add word count and character set controls
- Task 4: Text Generation Engine (AC: 1, 5) - Implement flexible text generation system - Add word-based text generation logic - Add character-based text generation logic - Optimize for performance and variety
- Task 5: Testing and Quality Assurance (All ACs) - Unit tests for word frequency algorithms - Unit tests for character set management - Integration tests with existing typing engine - Performance testing for text generation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Given I select Word mode, when the mode loads then common words are generated for practice 2. Given I select Word mode, when the mode loads then I can adjust word count for sessions 3. Given I select Word mode, when the mode loads then words are ordered by frequency of use 4. Given I select Character mode, when I configure character sets then I can select specific character groups 5. Given I select Character mode, when I configure character sets then practice text is generated from selected characters 6. Given I select Character mode, when I configure character sets then finger-based character grouping is available

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR-020: Generate practice text from common word lists, FR-021: Adjustable word count for sessions, FR-022: Focus on frequently used words, FR-023: Allow custom character set selection

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: Component-based React architecture with feature-based organization, unidirectional data flow, and Firebase as backend-as-a-service

doc.title: Frontend Architecture
doc.snippet: Build custom components using Tailwind CSS for complete design control and consistency, lightweight approach with no additional component library overhead

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Implement diverse practice modes (Quote, Word, Character, Lesson, Code, Numbers) that provide varied typing experiences catering to different learning needs and skill levels

code.reason: Core typing component providing character-by-character highlighting and input handling. Must be extended for Word and Character modes.
Comprehensive typing engine with session management, metrics calculation, and timer functionality. Provides WPM, accuracy, and performance tracking integration.
Existing mode selection system with mode interface patterns. Needs to be extended to include Word and Character mode options.
Form control patterns for settings. Should be used as reference for word count and character set controls.
Firebase integration for storing word databases, character sets, and user preferences.
Existing type system that will be extended with Word and Character mode types.

constraint.name: Performance Requirement
constraint.description: Must maintain existing typing latency (<50ms performance requirement)

constraint.name: Architecture Pattern
constraint.description: Extend existing TypingArea component to maintain consistency with Quote Mode

constraint.name: Data Storage
constraint.description: Use established Firebase patterns for storing word databases and character sets

constraint.name: Component Consistency
constraint.description: Follow existing component organization patterns from src/components/ and Settings.tsx form controls

constraint.name: Mode Integration
constraint.description: Leverage existing ModeSelector component for seamless mode switching

constraint.name: Performance Optimization
constraint.description: Text generation should be fast and non-blocking with optimized lookup algorithms

constraint.name: Language Support
constraint.description: Support multiple languages (English, Vietnamese) as specified in requirements

tests.standards: Unit tests using Jest and React Testing Library following existing patterns. Test files should be co-located with components using .test.tsx naming convention. Integration testing with Firebase Firestore emulator. Performance testing for text generation algorithms. Target 80% code coverage for new Word and Character mode components.
